what: While the hero frame stays pinned to the screen (it does not share space with later content, so the next section passes beneath it) and scrolls one screen, the cover panel (topic intro) that was below the frame rises by its own height and covers it, the picture behind recedes with blur 40px · opacity .5 · scale 1.05, and the corner logo shrinks to .9× — cover·blur take a .9 share, logo a .5 share, and the end .5 share is a hold (no curve, scrub). in: if on, right after pinning the picture sharpens from brightness 3 · blur 4px · scale 1.05 over 2.5s power2.out

options.spacing: When on, content below is pushed down while pinned (default off — like the original, the next section gets margin-top 100svh)
options.in: If on, applies the initial focus-in
